data.one_liner: Secure OIDC token storage using flutter_secure_storage and shared_preferences
data.what_it_does: Provides a default implementation of OidcStore that persists tokens and state across app launches. It uses flutter_secure_storage for sensitive data and shared_preferences for non-sensitive data, supporting Android, iOS, web, macOS, Windows and Linux.
use_when: You need a ready‑made, secure storage layer for an OIDC client in a Flutter app
You want cross‑platform persistence without writing custom storage code
avoid_when: You require a custom storage backend (e.g., a database or encrypted file)
You are building a non‑Flutter Dart project
weaknesses: Depends on flutter_secure_storage, which may need platform‑specific setup
Limited to key‑value storage, not full database features
data.setup_notes: Add oidc_default_store to pubspec.yaml and run flutter pub get. No additional permissions or build_runner needed.
